Exclusive neighborhoods for offsets 1 and 3 exactly forbid omission distances 1,2,5,6,7; checking offsets 2,4 and >=5 establishes sufficiency. A 128-state closed-walk trace enumerates exactly the admissible cyclic omission binary words. Gap lengths and their adjacency obstruction prove an unrestricted four-periodic extremal law, complete equality cases, and exceptional automorphism orbit stabilizers. Independent exhaustive direct-definition tests for n=3..16, independent equivalence checks n=12..16 and independent polynomial transfer counts n=12..40 all passed. Finite checks do not replace the infinite proof; residual possible human algebra-reading error remains.

value.rationale: One natural infinite family of degree-four ring-neighborhood networks is solved for the fault-tolerant detector invariant: all feasible sensor-set cardinalities by a fixed 128-state transfer, sharp four-periodic minimum, complete optimal configuration census with exceptional multiplicities at orders 22 and 23. This is mathematically more informative than a minimum scalar: an exact structural graph reduction and gap constraints extend to enumerative questions. The general problem is NP-hard, giving natural motivation to this tractable nontrivial family.
